items.title: Map management-group identifiers to ResourceIdentifier in C#
items.summary: Three managementGroupId model properties gain C#-specific @@alternateType customizations from string to armResourceIdentifier. The REST wire contract is unchanged, but regenerated C# SDK property types change for all API versions where those properties are present.

inferenceResults.rationale: The added C# @@alternateType augmentations directly change three existing generated public property types without altering the REST wire representation.
